sources: https://norwalkwi.gov/park-campground/ (Village of Norwalk 'Village Park & Campground' page, read live with the headless browser, desktop Chrome UA, 2026-11-20): '104 Mill St, Norwalk, WI - Right along the scenic Elroy-Sparta Bike Trail (Between Tunnels 2 & 3)'; 'Restrooms & Free Showers: On-site facilities available to campers (donations welcome).'; 'Premium RV Campsites: 8 newly renovated sites in 2024 (Approx. 37' X 60' with 18' X 60' gravel pads, fire rings, and 1 picnic table).'; 'Full Utility Hookups: Every RV site features access to Electric, Water, and Sewer hookups.'; 'Reservations are highly encouraged, but not needed (Must be paid at time of booking/reserving). A $20.00 cancellation fee applies'; 'CALL (608) 823-7760 TO BOOK'; 'RV Sites (Full Hookups) 1-Night Stay $45.00 / 2-Night Stay $80.00 / Each Additional Night (After Night 2) $25.00 / night'; 'Maximum of 1 RV unit plus 1 tent or 2 tents per site'; free tent area (first 3 nights free, then $10); 'Stay limit: Maximum of 13 nights in any 30-day period'; layout map: sites #1-#8 off a campground drive between Mill St and the bike trail, restrooms + showers, drinking fountain, shelters, pulling track and bleachers, Moore Creek beyond the track.
